segments.text: The tiny Tata Punch just got a TURBO — 118 horsepower of it. Wait... what?!
That 1.2 turbo punches out 170 Nm through a slick 6-speed manual — this baby SUV suddenly means business.
And it's tough — a full 5-star Global NCAP safety score, on a car this small and this cheap.
The kicker? It starts at just ₹5.59 lakh, and hides a massive 366-litre boot. That is serious value.
So: turbo power, five-star safety, sub-four-metre size, under six lakh. Tata, how is this even legal?
Which car next — Nexon or Brezza? Tell us below, and smash that like, share, subscribe!
